name: Force
desc: Feeds Pressure (force + grip). Deals bludgeoning damage: 0.7 x points^1.25.

name: Reach
desc: Feeds Awareness (clairvoyance x reach) and lowers Acuity. Spread = reach + 0.5 x √Awareness. Each point of spread splashes 20% of the strike onto flankers (up to 75%); at 4 spread the spell hits every enemy. Does nothing unless other axes give the spell a strike or an effect to deliver.

name: Grip
desc: Feeds Pressure (force + grip) and Purchase (grip / (1 + speed)). Each point gives an 18% chance to inflict Dazed and adds damage: 0.25 x points^1.25. Purchase sets how long afflictions stay on the target.

name: Speed
desc: Cooldown x0.93 per point. Momentum = mass x speed; speed also lowers Inertia (mass minus speed) and Purchase (grip / (1 + speed)). Does nothing unless other axes give the spell a strike or an effect to deliver.

name: Clairvoyance
desc: Feeds Acuity (makes the strike piercing, unmissable and armor-penetrating) and Awareness (widens the spell to more enemies). The inward share of Acuity is Foresight: attacks against you have a chance to miss.

name: Space
desc: Feeds Coherence (space / (force + mass)), which withholds part of the strike’s damage, multiplies Acuity’s armor penetration by (1 + Coherence), and sets how long every inward effect lasts.

name: Mass
desc: With speed it becomes Momentum (a bludgeoning strike of 0.85 x (√Momentum)^1.25, and concussion); without speed it becomes Inertia (Kinetic Bulwark outward, blunt resistance inward).

name: Vitality
desc: Sets Inward (vitality / (vitality + pressure)): the share of every quantity applied to you instead of the target. Also heals you: 0.35 x points^1.25 x (0.5 + Inward) spell power.
